boundaries: The conference representative C is prior EPR/Born input to this crosswalk, not reconstructed from the balanced-release packet itself.
The audit does not prove that physical/registered history averages the orientation character with mean 1/sqrt(5).
The audit does not prove the native source uses the N^2-5m^2 feedback controller.
J_BR is explicitly not an element of the normal deck V4; T10 and T12 are distinct quotient transports, not two deck lifts of one motion.
earned_statement: The same S5 quotient of Aut(G60) acts faithfully on six canonical Sylow-5 axes and on the switching class of the order-6 conference matrix. Under one global relabeling, the conference orientation character (+C versus -C, up to diagonal switching) equals the ordinary 60-vertex permutation-sign character for all 480 automorphisms. Hence T10 is conference-even, while T12 and J_BR are conference-odd.
scope: Bridges the independently reconstructed MM/balanced-release transport selectors to the prior six-axis conference representative. It derives the six quotient axes intrinsically as the six Sylow-5 subgroups of Aut(G60)/V4 and compares their degree-6 action to the conference switching/anti-switching symmetry group.
